participation.context: Fed him and did not ask for a plot.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Promised not to touch the papers, and blamed the cat in advance.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You said what you were playing and told them not to move the board.

title: Said Two Gentlemen was at two and the sheets stay

participation.context: Marked the moon and left the rest of the line empty.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You ticked the full moon and shut the almanac.
